text_block_list.text:
Did you bear witness, Trainer?
To the moment of my triumph.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
This victory is but a single petal of the
splendor blooming across the Kingdom of the
Rose.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
When weighed against the prosperity we shall
soon build, it could be deemed trivial,
and yet...

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
To know that the days walked alongside you
became fertile soil
from which this blossomed brings me genuine
joy.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
For now,
let us share in the joy of this victory
together.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Indeed, momentum is essential at times.
We shall forge ahead without breaking our
stride.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Heh, that attitude of never yielding to
complacency.
It is truly reassuring.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Naturally,
I shall not drop my guard either.
I am prepared for whatever training you
prescribe.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
I have already entrusted my very person to you,
Trainer.
Do not hesitate to push me to my limits.
